reading.version_is: the coordinate every repository on family/1 shares (records/DRAFT-a-shared-tag-asserts-interoperability.md in the corpus): an implementation pins the version it replayed in its own suite, and `uv run qm interop` compares each pin against this one
reading.cases_are: what `hearth check` asserts, by side, in the order it asks; a case with `needs` is asked only when the runner is given it
reading.a_tag: hearth tags a version only once every repository on the surface has replayed it

member.asks: GET /family/state is {member, cue, state} for the same member
a body that is not JSON is refused 422 with its error
an action it does not take is refused 422 with its error
a refused cue changes nothing, the record of the last cue included
GET /family/events streams the state at once
the cue reaches a follower as an event

hub.asks: the hub's identity names its hub
the hub's identity names its family
the hub's identity names its instance
GET /family/ lists the members and the recent deliveries
a name the hub's table does not hold has no members route
GET /family/members/{pull}/events streams the action at once
